purpose: Teach: お手数/公費/机上/納める/コーポレート/コメンテーター/盛り込む/旅先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室に、本気で、絶対、お手数、絶対、おかけするが、絶対、頼むぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to take real responsibility in the lab. This matters. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Steady eye contact. Weight behind each request. The tone of someone who sees potential and will not let it slip away.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の、本気で、絶対、公費、絶対、申請、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm moving forward with the research funding applications. Thank you for your trust.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Not obsequious. Clear, measured pace. The voice of someone taking the weight seriously but not buckling under it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 机上の、本気で、絶対、理論、絶対、だけでなく、絶対、実地でも、絶対、検証しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't just work from theory. You need to test things in the field too. Actually verify it.
lines.style: Slight edge of emphasis on 'test' and 'field'. Lean forward slightly in the voice. Practical, no-nonsense. The mentor correcting before problems start.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、本気で、絶対、奨学金、絶対、納める、絶対、よう、絶対、手続きしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already completed the paperwork for the scholarship. I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Quiet confidence underneath the politeness. Not rushing. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. Shows he's already ahead of the curve.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 大学の、本気で、絶対、コーポレート、絶対、研究、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Look at what the university's corporate research partners are doing. Learn from them.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact directive. Brief pause after 'Look'. Tone that opens a door rather than closes one. Suggesting, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当該分野の、本気で、絶対、コメンテーター、絶対、教授に、絶対、お会いしてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already met with the leading professors in the field to discuss their approaches.
lines.style: Slight warmth now — showing initiative. Steady, not defensive. The subtext: I understood what you needed before you had to spell it out.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文に、本気で、絶対、最新の考え、絶対、盛り込む、絶対、よう、絶対、頼むぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure your paper includes the latest thinking. Don't let it go stale. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Slight urgency underneath. Lean in on 'latest'. The tone shifts from instruction to something almost protective — he does not want to see good work wasted.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会、本気で、絶対、旅先、絶対、教授と、絶対、議論、絶対、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm presenting at the conference and will be discussing recent developments with my colleagues there. Thank you.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the voice. The closing note of a conversation that landed well. Steady, clear, showing he has integrated the entire conversation into his plans.
